title: baloo config
description: baloo's settings for a repo, in .claude/baloo.yml at its root. Each Check and each Guideline turns on or off with a key of its own.

output-style.description: The plugin's Output style for Claude's replies, picked at session start in the settings file that enables the plugin (the project's .claude/settings.local.json for the user's settings), where no settings file of Claude Code's picks one; false picks none.

status-line.description: The plugin's Status line, set at session start in the project's .claude/settings.local.json, where no settings file of Claude Code's but the user's own sets one; false takes it out. Its bars and thresholds instead of true.

bars.description: The bars shown, in this order; all four without it.

thresholds.description: The percentages at which a bar turns yellow and red: of what is used, from them up; for cache, of its lifetime left, below them. One left out keeps its default: context 15 and 20, cache 40 and 20, 5h 70 and 85, 7d 80 and 95.

session-review.description: The Session review: when a session ends, a separate Claude session proposes, in .about/proposals/, changes to .about/ for what the conversation settled or left open but nobody wrote down; a later session shows you each, to accept, reject or defer. It never edits .about/ or commits.

format-on-edit.description: The command run, with sh in the repo's root and the file's path at the end, after each of Claude's edits to a file in the repo, such as npx prettier --write; nothing is said of how it went. Off without it, or with false.

guidelines.description: The plugin's Guidelines, files of working rules: each one true is named to Claude at session start, for Claude to read when a task calls for it, but typescript, vue and testing, which Claude is given whole the first time it reads or edits a file of their subject in a session.

principles.description: Principles for non-trivial work, with the rules for every task, which session start prints whole.

design.description: Design: what a module shows and hides, and where it is tested from.

testing.description: Testing: writing tests and building test-first.

debugging.description: Debugging: finding a bug's cause before fixing it.

writing-for-agents.description: Writing for agents: skills, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, prompts.

ci.description: CI: fixing a failed run, reproducing its failed step locally first.

dependencies.description: Dependencies: updating outdated ones in green commits, majors only once picked.

go.description: Go: the choices where more than one would be reasonable.

typescript.description: TypeScript: the choices where more than one would be reasonable.

vue.description: Vue 3 with TypeScript: components, composables, Pinia stores, their tests.

tailwind.description: Tailwind CSS: theme tokens, dark mode, class names, configuration.

claude-hooks.description: The Checks in Claude Code's hooks, each on with true and off with false; on without their key too.

no-git-hook-bypass.description: Denies a Bash command that would bypass the Git hooks: --no-verify, core.hooksPath, HUSKY=0.

no-secrets-in-context.description: Denies a tool call that would show a secret to Claude, such as reading an env file or printing the environment, or mark an env file as holding none.

git-hooks.description: The Checks in Git hooks, on every commit or push, each on with true and off with false; off without their key. The Git hooks are written where at least one of their Checks is on.

no-ai-coauthor.description: commit-msg: no AI as a commit's co-author, and no line crediting one; a person's Co-Authored-By passes. Session start also turns off Claude Code's commit attribution where no settings file sets it.

conventional-commits.description: commit-msg: the message is a Conventional Commit, as commitlint's config-conventional reads it; its settings instead of true.

types.description: The types a subject may have, or any.

max-length.description: The longest line, in characters; 0 for no limit. 100 without it.

no-secrets-in-commits.description: pre-commit: the staged changes add no secret and no env file; baloo:allow-secret marks a false alarm.

no-stale-adr-date.description: pre-commit: an ADR the staged changes change has today's Date.

no-conflict-markers.description: pre-commit: the staged changes add no conflict marker, as git diff --check finds them, in a file where one opens or closes a conflict; a longer conflict-marker-size in .gitattributes lets a file hold them.

no-large-files.description: pre-commit: the staged changes add no file over 1024 KB; a file already committed passes. Its settings instead of true.

max-size.description: The largest file a commit may add, in KB. 1024 without it.

linear-history.description: pre-push: the push sends no merge commit.
